title: Gabbard Diagram for Low Earth Orbit 1959-2021
summary: An animated Gabbard diagram of objects in low Earth orbit from 1959 to 2021, showing altitude over time. It highlights major debris-generating events and how low-altitude debris decays out of orbit.
why: HN uses it to illustrate orbital debris evolution and how altitude determines how fast debris decays.

quote.text: See this video for evolution of debris and altitude over time
